memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports able to drive school bus, manages household chores, no difficulty walking.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (recall 2 of 3, clock draw normal) – negative screen.
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds – normal fall risk.
medicines: 1 regular (sertraline 50 mg OD). Not polypharmacy.
mood: PHQ-9 12 (moderate depression); reports low mood, anhedonia, fatigue.
carers: Ramesh, husband
goals: "I want to feel energetic enough to enjoy my work and time with my son."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
sertraline 50 mg OD
Start today, continue for 8 weeks, review.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Driving bus without issue; reports mild fatigue after long shifts.
cognition: Mini-Cog not repeated (annual schedule).
falls: No falls; gait normal; timed up-and-go 9 seconds – normal risk.
medicines: 1 regular (sertraline 50 mg OD). Not polypharmacy.
mood: PHQ-9 10 (mild depression); reports improved mood but occasional insomnia.
carers: Ramesh, husband
goals: "I want to sleep better and feel less tired during my routes."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
sertraline 50 mg OD
Continue.
escitalopram 10 mg OD
Start today, take in the morning.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling more upbeat but still wake up at 3 am and can’t get back to sleep. The bus routes are fine, just tired in the mornings.

memories.author: D06

Continue.

Continue.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 20 Jan 2026 at 10:30 am with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Bus driving without difficulty; reports less night waking, still occasional daytime drowsiness.
cognition: Mini‑Cog not repeated (annual).
falls: No falls; gait normal; timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds – normal risk.

carers: Ramesh, husband
goals: "I’d like to cut down on medicines if possible and feel alert all day."
